# Create HTML Form

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Create HTML Form

We use the <form> tag to create an HTML form. For example,

```html
<form>
    <!-- form elements here -->
</form>
```

Inside the <form> tag, we can place different form elements such as text fields, checkboxes, submit buttons, etc. For example,

```html
1<form>
2    <p>Enter your name:</p>
3    <input type="text" name="name">
4
5   <input type="submit">
6</form>
```

Browser Output

![Creating an HTML form.](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, we have created a form with

- A text asking the user to input a name.
- A text field to type the name.
- A button to submit the name.

By the way, HTML can only create a form structure. We need to use programming languages such as JavaScript or Python to process the form (i.e. store or validate form data).
